dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: About forging commissions, I've left those to my apprentice Hajime. Go talk to him about any such matters.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about Amenoma Smithy.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Amenoma Smithy is a place for Amenoma Art followers to forge, smelt, and sell weapons.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Is there anything else I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Farewell. Weapons can be dangerous. Take care of yourself on the journey.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about the Amenoma Art...

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Among the swordsmiths in Inazuma, some speak of the Raiden Gokaden.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: It is said that in ancient times, a ronin passed the process of forging down to five of his disciples. Each of the five different techniques has its own secrets.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Amenoma Art is one of them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can I ask about swords and blades in Inazuma?

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Oh, are you also interested in the Inazuman weapons? Seems like you're something of a master of the sword yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: We Inazuman artisans use a special material called Jade Steel, which is produced from Tatarasuna, when forging weapons. It makes the sword tougher and sharper. That's the reason why Inazuman weapons are some of the best in the world.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Naturally, we have also inherited the techniques of forging weapons using Jade Steel. The key to that is using our perseverance to bring out the strength of the steel.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got any tricks of the trade to share?

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: If you want to learn about some special forging trick, then you've come to the wrong place.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Amenoma Art is different from the others. We don't have any secret forging tricks to offer. The only thing we can tell you is that you will need patience and the willpower to give everything you have.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Everyone who visits Amenoma Smithy has witnessed our skill in forging weapons. However, only very few have enough perseverance to carry on the spirit of the Amenoma Art.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Only by creating a superior piece of work with relentless persistence and patience can you inherit the Amenoma name.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The blades aren't exactly the same as the ones in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Yeah, the materials and methods used to forge the weapons aren't the same, so the resulting weapons would be of a different style as well.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: I heard that Liyue's Archon, Rex Lapis, was skilled at the forging of weapons. Previously, I was curious about what the blades made in Liyue were like.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: So a while ago, I requested someone from the Crux Fleet to bring a weapon made in Liyue to me. I learned a lot after studying that weapon.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Now, I have fully grasped the techniques that were used to forge that weapon. Seeing as you have deep connections with Liyue, I'll gift this weapon to you.
